/* selectLongTermNotConnected - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT X1.USER_ID FROM ( SELECT X.USER_ID, CASE WHEN X.FRST_REG_DT IS NULL THEN X.JOIN_DT ELSE X.FRST_REG_DT END AS LAST_LOGIN_DT FROM ( SELECT AA.USER_ID, TO_DATE(AA.JOIN_APRV_YMD || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS JOIN_DT, G.FRST_REG_DT
FROM SAA200 AA /* 사용자 */
LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.FRST_RGTR_ID, T.FRST_REG_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.FRST_RGTR_ID ORDER BY T.FRST_REG_DT DESC) AS RN FROM SAB930 T /* 접속 로그 */ WHERE T.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = 'I' AND T.LGN_SCS_YN = 'S' ) G ON G.FRST_RGTR_ID = AA.USER_ID AND G.RN = 1
WHERE AA.JOIN_APRV_YMD IS NOT NULL AND AA.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = '2' AND AA.USER_CNTN_INTRCP_YN = 'N' AND AA.ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL
) X ) X1
WHERE X1.LAST_LOGIN_DT < SYSDATE - ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(STNG_PARA_VALUE1) FROM SAB710 /* 환경설정 */ WHERE STNG_ID = 'SYSTEM_ENV' )
